verdict.rationale: Companies House's own pages list online filing transactions: filing abridged or full accounts, changing a registered office address, and a service to "file certain documents online instead of posting a paper form." Identity verification is also offered as an online service. Missing for 10: any evidence that company incorporation/registration can be done online, online fee payment, coverage of all filings rather than only "certain documents", and hands-on corroboration of a completed filing.
